name: Israel
note: Israel in the style of the Russian model tree: coalition politics with alternative coalitions led by real parties (centrist, left, religious, national, socialist), security, military, economy (the offshore gas fields), foreign policy and society branches; sourced starting spirits in data/spirits/isr.json and decisions in data/decisions/isr.json. Wars stay in the scripted conflict events. Alternatives are a counterfactual, not a claim about the parties.

source.title: Wikipedia: Basic Law: Israel as the Nation-State of the Jewish People

focuses.name: The coalition question
focuses.description: Every Israeli government is a coalition; the question is which parties lead it.

focuses.name: Coalition politics
focuses.description: Governments formed by the largest party with smaller partners, as Israel has always been governed.

focuses.name: A centrist wave
focuses.description: Secular centrist parties draw voters from both blocs.

focuses.name: New faces
focuses.description: Candidates from the army, the media and business join the centre.

focuses.name: Civil marriage
